📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-03
1. Anthropic swings back to an operating loss in Q3, compute commitments near $895B產業
Anthropic 第三季本業再度轉虧，算力承諾逼近 9,000 億美元
In an amended S-1 filed with the SEC, Anthropic reported Q3 revenue up 1,127% year over year to $17B, but an operating loss of $567M versus a $974M profit in Q2. Its purchase and lease commitments total $895.4B, mostly for AI compute and infrastructure.
Anthropic 向 SEC 提交修訂版 S-1，第三季營收年增 1,127% 至 170 億美元，但營業損失 5.67 億美元，較第二季獲利 9.74 億美元再度轉虧。已簽訂的採購與租賃承諾達 8,954 億美元，多半用於 AI 算力與基礎設施。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180163
2. Amadeus breach hits at least 12 airlines across Japan, South Korea, Malaysia and Hong Kong資安
西班牙 Amadeus 遭駭波及多國航空公司，至少 12 家航空公司受影響
Unauthorized access to Spanish airline IT provider Amadeus has spread to carriers in several countries. At least 12 airlines and one reservation-system provider have issued notices, and some confirm that passenger booking data was viewed.
西班牙航空資訊系統業者 Amadeus 遭未授權存取，日本、南韓、馬來西亞與香港至少 12 家航空公司及 1 家訂位系統業者發布公告，部分業者確認旅客訂位資料遭查閱。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180146
3. Anthropic warns it is very close to RSI capability, or self-building AI研究
Anthropic 警告已非常接近遞迴自我改進（RSI）能力
RSI is the point at which AI becomes so good at training itself that AI capabilities accelerate dramatically. Anthropic says it is very close to that capability.
RSI 指 AI 強到能自行訓練自己，進而讓 AI 能力急遽加速的臨界點。Anthropic 表示自己已非常接近這項能力。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/anthropic-warns-that-its-very-close-to-rsi-capability-aka-self-building-ai/
4. OpenAI merges ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs, with ChatGPT and Codex sharing one usage pool產品
OpenAI 合併 ChatGPT 的 Chat 與 Work 分頁，ChatGPT 與 Codex 共用額度
After the change, ChatGPT and Codex will draw usage from the same allocation pool. From December, Plus, Pro and Business plans will count usage in tokens, and more advanced models and complex tasks use more of the pool.
合併後 ChatGPT 與 Codex 將從同一個額度池扣用量。自 12 月起，Plus、Pro 及 Business 方案以 Token 計算用量，進階模型與複雜任務消耗較多。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/openai-is-finally-merging-chatgpts-chat-and-work-tabs/
5. Apple's Q4 revenue grows 12% to a record for the period, led by iPhone and Mac產業
蘋果 Q4 營收成長 12% 創同期新高，iPhone 與 Mac 業務強勁
For the fiscal fourth quarter ended Sept. 26, Apple reported revenue up 12% to $114.5B, net income up 12% to $30.7B, and EPS up 14% to $2.10. Gross margin was 47.9%.
截至 9 月 26 日的 2026 財年第四季，蘋果營收年增 12% 至 1,145 億美元，淨利成長 12% 至 307 億美元，每股盈餘成長 14% 至 2.10 美元，毛利率 47.9%。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180162
6. The New York Times sues Brave over AI scraping and paywall bypassing政策
紐約時報控告 Brave 瀏覽器涉及 AI 爬取內容與繞過付費牆
The New York Times and other publications filed lawsuits against Brave's maker. They allege unlawful scraping of copyrighted content for AI training and distribution to customers such as Anthropic and Perplexity, and that Brave lets users bypass paywalls.
紐約時報等多家媒體對 Brave 開發商提告，指控其未經授權爬取受版權保護的內容用於 AI 訓練，並提供給 Anthropic、Perplexity 等客戶，同時讓使用者繞過付費牆。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/tech/1024588/brave-lawsuit-ai-scraping-new-york-times
7. Hackers remotely raise temperatures in freezers at over 115 supermarkets in 7 European countries資安
歐洲 7 國逾 115 家超市冷凍設備遭駭客操控，遠端調高溫度導致食品損失
In early October, attackers targeted Danfoss control systems at hundreds of French supermarkets and remotely triggered defrost cycles, ruining large amounts of food. Similar attacks have now spread to other European countries.
10 月上旬法國數百家超市冷凍冷藏控制系統遭攻擊，駭客鎖定 Danfoss 控制系統遠端啟動除霜功能，造成大量食品報廢，類似攻擊如今蔓延到其他歐洲國家。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180165
8. OpenAI pitches "Grid Protectors" to free up data center power during emergencies政策
OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors 計畫，極端天候時釋出資料中心電力
OpenAI will pilot the program at a data center in Effingham County, Georgia. It promises to free up to 1,000 MW during extreme weather or emergencies, enough for air conditioners in about 700,000 homes.
OpenAI 將在喬治亞州 Effingham 郡的資料中心試行此計畫，承諾在極端天候或緊急情況下釋出最多 1,000 百萬瓦電力，足夠約 70 萬戶家庭使用冷氣。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1024604/openai-data-center-grid-protection-program
9. Cisco open-sources Project Quarry to detect suspicious AI agent behavior產品
思科開源 AI 代理偵測工具 Quarry，可分析多步驟操作找出可疑行為
Project Quarry analyzes an AI agent's tool calls, tool results and the order of its operations during a task. It helps security teams spot suspicious behavior.
Project Quarry 可分析 AI 代理執行任務期間的工具呼叫、執行結果與操作先後順序，協助資安團隊辨識可疑行為。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180074
10. OpenAI introduces LifeVal, a benchmark for everyday tasks研究
OpenAI 推出 LifeVal，衡量 AI 協助日常事務的基準測試
LifeVal measures how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and handling government paperwork.
LifeVal 用來衡量 AI 協助完成日常任務的能力，範圍涵蓋找托育、管理財務到處理政府文件。
OpenAI · https://openai.com/index/lifeval
